{{Top|leg}}
The '''System-7''' was an [[Acceleration compensator/Legends|inertial compensator]] produced by [[Wegern]], and employed on the [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptor]]. It was theoretically capable of negating up to 100 Gs; however, this was untested as no combat maneuver had ever exceeded 64 Gs.
